domain_group: 广汽集团经营分析体系

metrics.definition: 统计周期内实际交付整车数量占同期预算目标交付量的比例。注意：fact_sales_daily 为日/车型粒度，dim_budget_target 为月度粒度，直接 JOIN 会产生 1:N 扇出，计算必须先使用 CTE 对事实表按月聚合再关联。
metrics.example_query: WITH s_agg AS (SELECT brand_name, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', sale_date) AS year_month, SUM(delivered_units) AS actual_units FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', sale_date) = '2025-03' GROUP BY brand_name, year_month) SELECT s_agg.brand_name, s_agg.actual_units, b.target_units, ROUND(s_agg.actual_units * 100.0 / NULLIF(b.target_units, 0), 2) AS fulfillment_rate FROM s_agg JOIN dim_budget_target b ON s_agg.brand_name = b.brand_name AND s_agg.year_month = b.year_month

metrics.definition: 统计周期内最终交付给终端消费者的整车数量合计。
metrics.example_query: SELECT model_name, SUM(delivered_units) AS total_units FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE sale_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY total_units DESC

metrics.definition: 整车开票总营收与交付总量的比值，反映产品结构与价格稳定性。
metrics.example_query: SELECT brand_name, ROUND(SUM(gross_revenue) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(delivered_units), 0), 2) AS avg_price FROM fact_sales_daily GROUP BY brand_name

metrics.definition: 统计周期内营销投放总支出与交付总量的比值，衡量市场获客与促销投入的综合产出效率。两表粒度不同，必须分别按维度聚合后再 JOIN 计算比值。
metrics.example_query: WITH m_agg AS (SELECT brand_name, SUM(expense_amount) AS total_expense FROM fact_marketing_expenses WHERE expense_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY brand_name), s_agg AS (SELECT brand_name, SUM(delivered_units) AS total_units FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE sale_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY brand_name) SELECT m_agg.brand_name, ROUND(m_agg.total_expense * 1.0 / NULLIF(s_agg.total_units, 0), 2) AS marketing_cost_per_car FROM m_agg JOIN s_agg ON m_agg.brand_name = s_agg.brand_name

metrics.definition: 特定推广渠道投放支出与所带来留资线索总量的比值，评估渠道采买效率。
metrics.example_query: SELECT channel_name, ROUND(SUM(expense_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(leads_generated), 0), 2) AS cpl FROM fact_marketing_expenses GROUP BY channel_name ORDER BY cpl ASC

metrics.definition: 实际交付量与进店意向客流量的比值，衡量终端门店的客流接待与成交转化效率。
metrics.example_query: SELECT region_name, ROUND(SUM(delivered_units) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(customer_leads), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate FROM fact_sales_daily GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC

metrics.definition: 特定推广渠道投放支出与所带来交付总营收的比值，评估渠道最终成交贡献的回报率（按品牌 + 月聚合后两表 JOIN）。
metrics.example_query: WITH m_agg AS (SELECT brand_name, SUM(expense_amount) AS total_spend FROM fact_marketing_expenses WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', expense_date) = '2025-03' GROUP BY brand_name), s_agg AS (SELECT brand_name, SUM(gross_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', sale_date) = '2025-03' GROUP BY brand_name) SELECT m_agg.brand_name, ROUND(s_agg.total_revenue * 1.0 / NULLIF(m_agg.total_spend, 0), 2) AS channel_roi FROM m_agg JOIN s_agg ON m_agg.brand_name = s_agg.brand_name

metrics.definition: 经销商当前库存台数与近 30 天日均交付量的比值，反映库存消化速度。周转天数越高代表滞销风险越大。
metrics.example_query: WITH latest_inv AS (SELECT dealer_name, brand_name, region_name, SUM(inventory_units) AS inventory_units FROM fact_dealer_inventory_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM fact_dealer_inventory_daily) GROUP BY dealer_name, brand_name, region_name), sales_agg AS (SELECT dealer_name, SUM(delivered_units) AS recent_30d_units FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE sale_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY dealer_name) SELECT latest_inv.dealer_name, latest_inv.brand_name, latest_inv.region_name, latest_inv.inventory_units, ROUND(latest_inv.inventory_units * 30.0 / NULLIF(sales_agg.recent_30d_units, 0), 1) AS turnover_days FROM latest_inv LEFT JOIN sales_agg ON latest_inv.dealer_name = sales_agg.dealer_name

metrics.definition: 经销商库存台数与近 30 天实际交付量的比值。> 1.5 视为预警，> 2.5 视为严重滞销。
metrics.example_query: WITH latest_inv AS (SELECT dealer_name, model_name, SUM(inventory_units) AS inventory_units FROM fact_dealer_inventory_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM fact_dealer_inventory_daily) GROUP BY dealer_name, model_name), sales_agg AS (SELECT dealer_name, model_name, SUM(delivered_units) AS recent_30d_units FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE sale_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY dealer_name, model_name) SELECT latest_inv.dealer_name, latest_inv.model_name, latest_inv.inventory_units, ROUND(latest_inv.inventory_units * 1.0 / NULLIF(sales_agg.recent_30d_units, 0), 2) AS inventory_coefficient FROM latest_inv LEFT JOIN sales_agg ON latest_inv.dealer_name = sales_agg.dealer_name AND latest_inv.model_name = sales_agg.model_name

metrics.definition: 客流转化漏斗 4 个阶段（进店/留资/试驾/成交）两两之间的转化率，基于事件表去重 session 计数。
metrics.join_condition: 通过 STRFTIME 截取年月聚合
metrics.example_query: WITH stage_counts AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', event_date) AS year_month, event_stage, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions FROM fact_funnel_event WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m', event_date) = '2025-03' GROUP BY year_month, event_stage) SELECT year_month, MAX(CASE WHEN event_stage='store_visit' THEN sessions END) AS visits, MAX(CASE WHEN event_stage='lead_created' THEN sessions END) AS leads, MAX(CASE WHEN event_stage='test_drive' THEN sessions END) AS drives, MAX(CASE WHEN event_stage='order_created' THEN sessions END) AS orders FROM stage_counts GROUP BY year_month
